findings.entity: Glass coffee carafe and wiping cloth
findings.description: At 00:21-00:23, the waitress is wiping the bare counter with a cloth in her right hand and no coffee pot is nearby. At 00:24, as she lifts her right hand from the counter, a full glass coffee carafe materializes directly in her hand in place of the cloth.
From 00:28 to 00:31, a heavy stream of coffee pours continuously out of the glass carafe into the mug, but the liquid level inside the clear carafe never decreases.

findings.entity: Plate of toast and fried egg
findings.description: At 00:36-00:44, the plate of toast and egg sits on the counter directly in front of the man. In the following shots at 00:45-00:50 and 01:00-01:08, the plate has vanished from the counter in front of him without being eaten or cleared, before appearing again with the waitress at 01:09.

At 01:09-01:12, the man has a white coffee mug on the counter in his left hand while the waitress sets a second white coffee mug down next to it into his right hand. At 01:13-01:14, as the waitress lets go and the man brings his hands together, the two side-by-side mugs merge into a single mug.

findings.entity: Plate of toast and fried egg
findings.description: At 01:15-01:17, the waitress picks up the untouched plate of food with both hands and walks away with it. On the cut to 01:18, the plate has vanished from her hands (replaced by a coffee mug), vanishes again from the counter in the close angle at 01:27-01:34, and reappears on the counter at 01:50.

In the opening shot at 00:00-00:09, the truck parked outside the diner is a white aerodynamic sleeper semi-cab. When the driver walks back out to his truck at 01:41, it has transformed into a dark green straight box truck with a white stripe.

findings.entity: White coffee mug near condiment station
findings.description: At 01:50-01:51, a second white coffee mug is sitting on the counter just to the left of the condiment station while the waitress picks up the first mug and plate. As she walks past at 01:52, the second mug remaining on the counter vanishes into thin air.
